name: Vampire - Vampire Weaknesses - Successes
description: Flavor text for successes a feature

results.text: With a flicker of crimson eyes, the threshold yields—an invitation granted under moonlight.
The stake plunges deep, freezing the vampire in eternal torment as shadows scream.
Running water spares its wrath as the beast skulks away from the liquid grave.
Sunlight's agony is embraced briefly before retreating to the safety of endless night.
The door groans open, welcoming death itself into the mortal abode.
